usedFor: StoreHippo takes the orders and Microsoft Excel keeps the sheet, so “New Order” can feed “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in StoreHippo, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each order is logged as a row, so you can total sales in a spreadsheet.

watchOut: “Add Row To Table” needs an existing Excel table to write into.
